description: Two amplifiers sharing one gain: the first multiplies by it, the second divides by it

params.text: Sets the gain, from 0.001 to 2 and unity in the middle of its travel; the tooltip reads it in dB

inputs.text: The signal to be multiplied by the gain
The signal to be divided by the gain
Adds to the gain at a fifth of a unit per volt, with the knob-plus-input total clamped between 0.001 and 2

outputs.text: The PRE input multiplied by the gain
The POST input divided by the gain

notes: sending the PRE output through an effect and bringing it back into the POST input returns the signal at the level it started at, whatever the gain is set to.
mono only: a polyphonic cable is read as its first channel and both outputs carry one channel.

inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0.001 to 2V.
